estimand: gamma_AH effect of A x H on the site loading to shared forcing

calibration.detection_rule: within each species and noise scenario, use the empirical 5th percentile of gamma_AH estimates generated under gamma_AH = 0 as the one-sided null threshold

interpretation: This is an oracle-forcing upper-bound recovery test conditional on the shared regional forcing being known.
It tests whether the frozen sampling schedule and predictor geometry can carry the A x H signal.
It does not validate latent-factor estimation, select a real effect size, or justify a power claim for the eventual demographic model.
High-noise loss of detection is a limitation to report, not a reason to tune the cohort, radius or predictor set.
boundary: No real demographic count magnitude is opened.
Simulation parameters cannot be changed after real outcomes are opened.
The simulation cannot be used to choose a more favorable species subset or alternative interaction.
